article.title: Louisville and Florida State meet in ACC play
article.linkText: Louisville and Florida State meet in ACC play
article.story: Florida State (3-2) at Louisville (2-3), Oct. 9 at 7 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Louisville by 4.5. Against the spread: Louisville 3-2, Florida State 2-2-1. How to watch: ESPN Key stats Louisville Offense Overall: 486 yards per game (17th in FBS) Passing: 287.4 yards per game (24th) Rushing: 198.6 yards per game (36th) Scoring: 38.6 points per game (22nd) Louisville Defense Overall: 423 yards per game (125th in FBS) Passing: 266.8 yards per game (130th) Rushing: 156.2 yards per game (92nd) Scoring: 29.2 points per game (113th) Florida State Offense Overall: 419 yards per game (51st in FBS) Passing: 225 yards per game (77th) Rushing: 194 yards per game (40th) Scoring: 33.2 points per game (58th) Florida State Defense Overall: 384.8 yards per game (102nd in FBS) Passing: 265.6 yards per game (127th) Rushing: 119.2 yards per game (44th) Scoring: 21.6 points per game (56th) Florida State ranks 98th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 40.5% of the time. Louisville ranks 41st on offense, converting on 45.6% of third downs. Florida State ranks 92nd in the FBS with a -2 turnover margin, compared to Louisville's 27th-ranked +4 margin. Louisville is 130th in the FBS with 82.4 penalty yards per game. Louisville is 63rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 83.3% of trips. Florida State's red zone offense ranks 1st, scoring on 100% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Louisville Passing: Lincoln Kienholz, 1,394 yards, 9 TDs, 1 INT, 69.1 completion percentage Rushing: Keyjuan Brown, 367 yards on 38 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Tre Richardson, 445 yards on 28 catches, 2 TDs Florida State Passing: Ashton Daniels, 1,111 yards, 6 TDs, 6 INTs, 60.3 completion percentage Rushing: Ousmane Kromah, 477 yards on 81 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Duce Robinson, 280 yards on 15 catches, 2 TDs Last game Louisville fell 31-28 to NC State on Oct. 3. Kienholz passed for 254 yards on 21-of-30 attempts (70.0%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 24 yards. Isaac Brown had 125 rushing yards on nine carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for zero yards. Richardson had eight receptions for 117 yards and one touchdown. Florida State won 38-7 over Virginia on Oct. 3. Daniels led Florida State with 183 yards on 12-of-19 passing (63.2%) for no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 17 times for 136 yards and five rushing touchdowns. Kromah carried the ball 17 times for 80 yards, adding two receptions for 13 yards. Micahi Danzy recorded 70 yards on four catches. Next game Louisville plays at Syracuse on Oct. 17. Florida State plays at No. 4 Miami (FL) on Oct. 17.
